question: Roswaal said to Subaru “After this, if you lose anyone around you who you should have protected, I will burn the rest without hesitation, and become ash myself as well.”. I can’t help but think that the people that Subaru wants to protect and those that Roswaal judges as people he should protect might not be exactly the same, but is that not the case?
answer: If Subaru can endure it without moving a muscle, he might be able to fool Roswaal as well, indeed. But, that’s impossible. The moment that Subaru cries after someone dies, it’s over.
